name: The Adventuring Party
description: A band of adventurers gathers at the tavern — each a different race, wielding a different weapon. Work out who's who.
clues: Abjuration goes with exactly two of Kael, Gnome, and Toad.
Between Abjuration and Enchantment, one goes with Fenwick and the other with Gnome.
Exactly one of these is true: Fenwick goes with Toad; Kael goes with Gnome; Wrenna goes with Wolf.
Tiefling goes with at least two of Wrenna, Evocation, and Toad.
Either Abjuration goes with Fenwick or Raven goes with Enchantment.
If Elf does not go with Fenwick, then Cat goes with Evocation.
Sable goes with none of Elf, Human, or Abjuration.
